method.text: Data is turned into 12 point-in-time indicators (rolling windows, z-scores on the history available at each date, publication lags for monthly series), grouped into three dimensions: stress, growth, inflation. Three models estimate the regime: a k-means baseline, a statistical jump model (persistent regimes, causal filtering) and a gradient boosting model that predicts the regime one week ahead. Every probability shown is out of sample (walk-forward). Stress episodes are dated by a rule fixed before testing.
